title.en: Predicted daily charge need !{{is|isn't}} above an amount

titleFormatted.en: Predicted daily charge need !{{is|isn't}} above [[kwh]] kWh

hint.en: True when the expected energy the car will need on the coming day (conditioned on its weekday) is above the given number of kWh. Use it to skip a smart-charging plan on days it barely needs a top-up.
